title: CTI2TTP: Evidence-Grounded TTP Extraction from Cyber Threat Intelligence via Diverge-then-Converge Verification
abstract: arXiv:2605.25836v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Extracting MITRE ATT&CK techniques from cyber threat intelligence (CTI) reports is an open-set, multi-label problem requiring both high recall (not missing techniques) and high precision (not hallucinating unsupported ones). Existing rule-based, supervised, and LLM-based methods struggle to achieve both: rule-based and supervised approaches lack generalizability across diverse attack descriptions, while LLM-based approaches that couple candidate generation and validation within a single inference step suffer from limited recall and precision simultaneously. We propose CTI2TTP, which addresses this challenge through a diverge-then-converge design inspired by how human analysts work: first extracting broadly, then verifying rigorously. Reports are first decomposed into atomic behaviors, each anchored by a deterministic span localization stage to a specific evidence window in the source text. Candidate techniques are then proposed

translated_title: CTI2TTP：通过发散-收敛验证从网络威胁情报中进行证据支持的技术、战术与程序（TTP）提取
translated_abstract: 从网络威胁情报（CTI）报告中提取MITRE ATT&CK技术是一个开放集、多标签问题，需要同时具备高召回率（不遗漏技术）和高精确率（不幻觉出不支持的技术）。现有的基于规则、监督学习和LLM的方法都难以同时兼顾这两点：基于规则和监督学习的方法在多样化的攻击描述上缺乏泛化能力，而将候选生成与验证耦合在单一推理步骤中的LLM方法则同时受到召回率和精确率的限制。我们提出CTI2TTP，借鉴人类分析师的工作方式，通过“先发散后收敛”的设计来应对这一挑战：先进行广泛提取，再进行严格验证。报告首先被分解为原子行为，每个原子行为通过确定性跨度定位阶段锚定到源文本中的特定证据窗口，随后提出候选技术。
tldr: 提出CTI2TTP框架，借鉴人类分析师“先发散、后收敛”的工作方式，通过将CTI报告分解为原子行为并锚定到具体证据窗口，同时实现高召回率与高精确率的MITRE ATT&CK技术提取。
en_tdlr: CTI2TTP introduces a diverge-then-converge framework that decomposes CTI reports into atomic behaviors anchored to specific evidence windows, achieving both high recall and high precision in extracting MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
